newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia ratifies deal with Amoco - agency.
newsitem.headline: Latvia ratifies deal with Amoco - agency.

text.p: The Latvian parliament on Thursday ratified in a first reading an oil exploration deal with U.S. oil firm Amoco and Swedish state-owned Olje Prospektering, news agency the Baltic News Service (BNS) said.

The deal is controversial as the area which Latvia's deal with Amoco covers is in waters that are still the subject of border negotiations between Latvia and neighbour Lithuania. But Latvia was under pressure to ratify the deal as it expired at the end of this month and would have had to be renegotiated.
BNS said the parliament backed the deal by 71 votes for and six against in the 100-seat house.
A second reading will be held on October 24.
The Latvians tried to find a formula to ease Lithuanian anger the agreement by insisting that the deal will only become valid once a sea border has been agreed.
Under the deal, Amoco and Olje Prospektering will prospect in a zone in the Baltic Sea called the Dalders region, most of which is in Swedish territorial waters.
But a small part of the exploration area was in the disputed Latvian and Lithuanian waters.
